dossier.purpose: Harbor is a Python (>=3.12, pyproject.toml:9) framework and CLI (`harbor`, aliases `hr`/`hb`: pyproject.toml:35-38) that runs agents against containerized tasks and records graded results. A task is a directory (instruction.md, task.toml, environment/ Dockerfile or compose, tests/test.sh, optional solution/: docs-mintlify/core-concepts/tasks/overview.mdx:6-20); a trial is one agent attempt on one task; a job is tasks x agents x attempts run with a concurrency limit (default 4: src/harbor/models/job/config.py:414-421) on local Docker/Podman/Apple container/Singularity or remote sandbox providers (29 EnvironmentType values: src/harbor/models/environment_type.py:4-33). Per trial: start environment, install and run the agent, upload tests/ and run the verifier, which must write /logs/verifier/reward.txt (one number) or reward.json (labeled numeric keys) (src/harbor/verifier/verifier.py:165-268), then persist result.json, agent logs, an ATIF trajectory, verifier logs and artifacts. 46 agent names are built in (src/harbor/models/agent/name.py:4-50), including real-CLI integrations `claude-code` and `codex` that install the vendor CLI inside the container at trial time. Optional pieces: RewardKit (criteria / LLM-judge verifier toolkit), Harbor Hub registry/upload/hosted rollouts (Supabase-backed), a local web viewer, `harbor analyze`/`check` (LLM-driven rubric review), and 85 benchmark adapters (adapters/*/README.md). Facts relevant to the three stated needs (no judgement): (1) multi-scorer values are kept per sample as a dict in each trial's result.json, but a 'case' is a task directory whose scorer code lives in its tests/ (or RewardKit files), not a labeled-dataset-plus-scorer registry; (2) containerized suites with the real Claude Code and Codex CLIs, each trial graded by a verifier, are directly supported; (3) no declarative CI regression gate (thresholds, baselines or reward-based exit status) was found.

claims.claim: Harbor is a framework from the creators of Terminal-Bench for evaluating and optimizing agents and language models.
Evaluate arbitrary agents like Claude Code, OpenHands, Codex CLI, and more.
Build and share your own benchmarks and environments.
Conduct experiments in thousands of environments in parallel through providers like Daytona, Modal, LangSmith, Blaxel, Novita Sandbox, Tensorlake, and Runta.
Install with `uv tool install harbor` or `pip install harbor`.
Harbor is the official harness for Terminal-Bench-2.0.
`harbor run --dataset terminal-bench@2.0 --agent claude-code --model anthropic/claude-opus-4-1 --n-concurrent 4` (with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) 'will launch the benchmark locally using Docker'.
To run on a cloud provider (like Daytona) pass the `--env` flag (`--env daytona`, with DAYTONA_API_KEY and e.g. `--n-concurrent 100`).
`harbor datasets list` explores all supported third-party benchmarks (like SWE-Bench and Aider Polyglot).
Evaluate an agent and model on a dataset with `harbor run -d "<dataset@version>" -m "<model>" -a "<agent>"`.
Absence noted: the README says nothing about telemetry, platform support (macOS/WSL2/GPU), tests/CI, security policy, the Python version requirement, or regression gating.

integrations.claude_code_or_codex: (1) As evaluated agents: `claude-code` and `codex` are built-in integrations that install the real CLI inside the task container and run it non-interactively, with ATIF trajectory output, resume, native/ATIF trajectory loading, native config files (settings.json / config.toml via --ak config=), skills and MCP registration (src/harbor/agents/installed/claude_code.py:98-112,425-450,1799-1917; src/harbor/agents/installed/codex.py:72-79,343-370,1362-1451; docs-mintlify/core-concepts/agents/pre-integrated-agents.mdx:88-143); `harbor trial handoff` resumes a finished Claude Code session locally with `claude --resume` (claude-code only: claude_code.py:184-210; src/harbor/cli/trials.py:873). Example job configs: examples/configs/agents/claude-code-job.yaml, codex-job.yaml (they use the deprecated `orchestrator:` key). (2) As judges inside verifiers: RewardKit agent judges download and run Claude Code or Codex (packages/rewardkit/src/rewardkit/agents.py:30-31,400-560); `harbor analyze`/`check` default to agent claude-code (src/harbor/cli/analyze.py:100-101,258-259). (3) For coding agents working on Harbor: six Claude Code skills in skills/ (create-task, create-adapter, harbor-exec, publish, rewardkit, upload-parity-experiments) installable by symlink with scripts/install-claude-skills.sh:1-16 or `npx skills add harbor-framework/harbor --skill rewardkit` (docs/content/docs/rewardkit/index.mdx:9-14); AGENTS.md (titled 'CLAUDE.md - Harbor Framework') plus packages/rewardkit/CLAUDE.md and apps/viewer/CLAUDE.md guide coding agents; the docs MCP endpoint above works with both CLIs.

readme.telemetry_and_network: README.md says nothing about telemetry or network requirements. TELEMETRY: on by default, no first-run notice or consent prompt found (src/harbor/cli/notifications.py only shows a registry tip). After CLI commands and jobs, a detached `python -c` helper POSTs `harbor.command_finished` and `harbor.job_finished` events to PostHog (https://us.i.posthog.com/i/v0/e/, hard-coded project key; requests.post, 10 s timeout, one attempt, dropped if offline) with an anonymous random install id stored at platformdirs user_config_path('harbor')/telemetry_id, person profiles and GeoIP disabled, and an allowlist of fields; opt out with HARBOR_TELEMETRY set to 0/false/no/off/disabled (src/harbor/telemetry.py:35-45,75-79,395-480,500-536; src/harbor/cli/main.py:53-77; src/harbor/job.py:1105,1115; docs/content/docs/usage-stats.mdx:6-101; docs-mintlify/telemetry/telemetry.mdx:6-41). Fields include agent/model names, dataset refs, environment type, token and cost totals, mean reward, feature flags, CI flag, `invoked_by` (detects CLAUDECODE, CODEX_SANDBOX etc.), and public git repo refs after an unauthenticated probe of the git host (telemetry.py:47-67,82-160,726-781). The test suite forces HARBOR_TELEMETRY=off (tests/conftest.py:14). Telemetry is not auto-disabled in CI (telemetry.py:580-581 only sets a `ci` field). No update checks or other analytics hosts found in src/ (searched for pypi.org, update checks, sentry/segment/mixpanel). HARBOR HUB: a Supabase project (https://ofhuhcpkvzjlejydnvyd.supabase.co, embedded publishable key, overridable with HARBOR_SUPABASE_URL) backs registry dataset resolution (default for `-d name@version`), package-task download (`-t org/name`), `harbor auth login` (OAuth, credentials in ~/.harbor/credentials.json), `upload`, `publish`, `--upload` and `--launch` (src/harbor/auth/constants.py:7-13,38-49; src/harbor/registry/client/factory.py:34-45; src/harbor/registry/client/harbor/harbor.py:23-27; src/harbor/tasks/client.py:368-388; src/harbor/cli/jobs.py:1263-1278). Local `-p` runs need no Harbor account; uploads are opt-in; hosted rollouts need access approval plus an API key (docs-mintlify/core-concepts/hosted-harbor/index.mdx:9-12). RUNTIME NETWORK for local Docker runs: image pulls/builds; in-container agent installs (downloads.claude.ai bootstrap.sh; nvm from raw.githubusercontent.com, nodejs.org and the npm registry for Codex: claude_code.py:444, codex.py:360-369); LLM endpoints with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY/OPENAI_API_KEY forwarded to the agent (claude_code.py:108-112; codex.py:1388-1399); git sparse clones for git-based tasks (src/harbor/tasks/client.py:233-331); verifier scripts that fetch tools (examples/tasks/hello-world/tests/test.sh:3-13). Claude Code is launched with CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC=1 (claude_code.py:1828). Task network policy defaults to `public` (src/harbor/models/task/config.py:250-251). OPT-IN extras: cloud sandbox accounts/keys, LangSmith/OTel/MLflow plugins (packages/harbor-langsmith/README.md:5-9), `harbor analyze`/`check` (default models claude-haiku-4-5 / claude-sonnet-4-6) and RewardKit LLM/agent judges (litellm provider credentials; installers from claude.ai and chatgpt.com: rewardkit/agents.py:30-31). The older docs/ site depends on @vercel/analytics (docs/package.json:14).

code.architecture: Typer CLI (src/harbor/cli/: main.py, jobs.py, trials.py, tasks.py, datasets.py, analyze.py, view.py, hub/auth/upload/publish) builds a JobConfig (src/harbor/models/job/config.py) -> Job.create/run (src/harbor/job.py, job_plan.py) expands tasks x agents x n_attempts into TrialConfigs and runs them through TrialQueue (src/harbor/trial/queue.py: asyncio semaphore, retry with include/exclude exception lists, default 0 retries) -> Trial (src/harbor/trial/trial.py base lifecycle; single_step.py, multi_step.py, regrade.py, artifact_handler.py, network_policy.py, simulated_user.py): environment start, agent setup/install, agent run, artifact collection, verifier, finalize and secret scrubbing. Agents: src/harbor/agents/ (base.py; installed/base.py BaseInstalledAgent with exec_as_agent, error-pattern classification into ApiRateLimitError/ApiUsageLimitError/AgentAuthenticationError/etc.; installed/claude_code.py, codex.py and ~44 others; terminus_2/ own agent; oracle.py runs the task solution; nop.py; factory.py with import-path and ACP agents). Environments: src/harbor/environments/ (base.py, factory.py lazy registry with pip-extra hints, docker/ compose runtime + nftables egress-control sidecar, podman.py, apple_container.py, singularity/, ~25 provider modules). Verifier: src/harbor/verifier/ (shared-container or separate verifier sandbox). Scoring/aggregation: src/harbor/models/{trial,job,verifier,trajectories (ATIF)}, src/harbor/metrics/ (mean/min/max/sum/uv_script), src/harbor/utils/pass_at_k.py. Hub/registry: src/harbor/registry/, tasks/client.py, download/, upload/, publisher/, hub/, hosted/, auth/, storage/ (Supabase). src/harbor/telemetry.py (PostHog). Viewer: src/harbor/viewer/ + apps/viewer. Workspace packages: packages/rewardkit (criteria -> dimensions -> reward.json + reward-details.json; LLM and agent judges), packages/harbor-langsmith and packages/harbor-atif2otel (job plugins). Other trees: adapters/ (85 benchmark converters, 84 with parity_experiment.json), examples/, skills/ (Claude Code skills), rfcs/, docs/ (Fumadocs) and docs-mintlify/ (deployed docs). Evidence layout per trial: config.json, lock.json, result.json, exception.txt, trial.log, agent/ (CLI output claude-code.txt / codex.txt, native sessions, trajectory.json), verifier/ (test-stdout.txt, reward.txt|json, e.g. ctrf.json or RewardKit reward-details.json), artifacts/ (+manifest.json); per job: config.json, lock.json (Harbor version/commit, task and skill digests), result.json (stats.evals with reward_stats, exception_stats, metrics, pass_at_k), job.log (src/harbor/models/trial/paths.py:84-146,189-305 [its docstring says results.json, the code writes result.json]; src/harbor/job.py:636-654; src/harbor/models/job/lock.py:60-63,143-148,175-195,266-274; src/harbor/models/job/result.py:15-26,129-169).
code.packaging_and_release: Build backend uv_build (pyproject.toml:40-42); PyPI package `harbor` (plus harbor-rewardkit, harbor-langsmith, harbor-atif2otel via scripts/publish-*.sh). Stable releases are cut by a maintainer running scripts/publish.sh locally: pytest (excluding live-provider tests), bun viewer build, `uv version --bump minor`, `uv build`, scripts/verify-wheel-extras.sh (resolves every extra), `uv publish --token "$UV_PUBLISH_TOKEN"`, then CITATION.cff update, annotated tag, push and `gh release create --generate-notes` with no attached assets (scripts/publish.sh:27-63). Nightly: .github/workflows/nightly.yml publishes a `.devYYYYMMDDHHMM` pre-release from main daily at 06:00 UTC using PyPI trusted publishing/OIDC (environment `pypi`, `uv publish --trusted-publishing always`; lines 8-56). No checksum, signature, SBOM or attestation step exists in the workflows or scripts (a search for attest/sigstore/cosign/sha256sum/SBOM/slsa/provenance matched only an unrelated adapter-review checklist line, .github/workflows/adapter-review.yml:732); whether PyPI attestations are produced implicitly cannot be determined from the repo. The viewer UI is built from apps/viewer and copied into src/harbor/viewer/static (gitignored: .gitignore:232) by scripts/build-viewer.sh at release time, so a plain source checkout lacks the UI until built with bun. The egress-control sidecar image is pinned by digest (src/harbor/environments/docker/harbor-docker-egress-control-sidecar/Dockerfile:1). Policy: stable releases 'usually biweekly', nightly daily (docs-mintlify/contributing/release-policy.mdx:6-36); versions 0.21.0 (2026-08-10), 0.22.0 (2026-08-22), 0.23.0 (2026-09-12) (docs-mintlify/changelog.mdx:6-49; CITATION.cff:7-8).
code.tests_and_ci: pytest (+pytest-asyncio auto mode, pytest-cov, pytest-xdist, hypothesis), ruff, ty (pyproject.toml:103-139,157-164; AGENTS.md:238-260); markers unit, integration, runtime (needs Docker), windows_containers. About 430 test_*.py files: 408 under tests/ (376 unit, 27 integration of which 10 are *_live.py provider tests with 9 explicitly ignored by scripts/publish.sh:27-38, 5 runtime) plus 13 in packages/rewardkit/tests, 3 in packages/harbor-langsmith/tests and 6 in packages/harbor-atif2otel/tests; tests/golden holds 13 JSON golden files for terminus_2. tests/conftest.py sets HARBOR_TELEMETRY=off (:14). Real-container e2e tests use the `oracle` agent (expects reward 1.0) and `nop` (0.0) (tests/integration/test_hello_user_e2e.py:25-54) and Harbor's own Terminus-2 against a fake aiohttp LLM server with golden trajectories (tests/integration/test_deterministic_terminus_2_invalid_json.py:1-60); claude-code/codex tests are AsyncMock-based (tests/unit/agents/installed/test_claude_code_install.py:14-34; test_agent_install_execution.py:47-71). CI = 15 workflow files in .github/workflows: pytest.yml (PR/push to main + manual; matrix ubuntu-26.04 and windows-2025; Python 3.13; `uv sync --all-packages --all-extras --locked`; Linux runs `pytest tests/ -m 'not runtime'` with coverage, starts the Podman socket, then `pytest tests/ -m runtime -n 4`; Windows runs non-runtime tests then `-m windows_containers`; Codecov upload with fail_ci_if_error false; only secret CODECOV_TOKEN: lines 3-104); ty.yml (`uv run ty check`); ruff-format.yml, named 'Ruff' (`ruff check .` and `ruff format --check .` on PRs); nightly.yml; check-registry-format.yml (registry.json format/duplicates); cff-validator.yml; sync-registry.yml (pushes registry.json to Supabase with secrets); update-parity-summary.yml (regenerates adapters/parity_summary.csv and commits to main); adapter-review.yml, claude.yml, claude-code-review.yml (anthropics/claude-code-action@v1); deploy-docs-preview.yml (Vercel, docs/); pr-labeler.yml, pr-diff-links.yml, reviewer-mentions.yml (pull_request_target). pytest.yml runs only `tests/`, so the package suites (rewardkit, harbor-langsmith, harbor-atif2otel) run in no workflow; they run in maintainer scripts (scripts/publish-rewardkit.sh:5; scripts/publish.sh:27-38 covers rewardkit and langsmith via testpaths, pyproject.toml:127; publish-harbor-langsmith.sh:5; publish-harbor-atif2otel.sh:5). No macOS job; Python 3.12 (declared minimum) is not in the matrix. Documented local checks: `uv run pytest tests/unit/`, `uv run ruff check --fix .`, `uv run ruff format .`, `uv run ty check` (AGENTS.md:218-260). Adapter practice: oracle run must reach 100% and parity run ranges must overlap (docs/content/docs/datasets/adapters.mdx:247-252,327-335); scripts/validate_adapter.py checks adapter structure.

code.security_policy: none - no SECURITY.md or equivalent anywhere in the clone (glob for SECURITY*/security* returned no files; .github/ holds only workflow YAMLs, labeler.yml and reviewer-mentions.json); no CODEOWNERS, dependabot config or .pre-commit-config.yaml either.

claim_checks.claim: README.md:12 - Evaluate arbitrary agents like Claude Code, OpenHands, Codex CLI, and more.
claim_checks.evidence: AgentName lists claude-code, codex, openhands and 43 more (src/harbor/models/agent/name.py:4-50); custom agents load by import path (src/harbor/agents/factory.py:114-128). claude-code: install() fetches the real CLI inside the container via `curl -fsSL https://downloads.claude.ai/claude-code-releases/bootstrap.sh | bash` (npm on Alpine) (src/harbor/agents/installed/claude_code.py:425-450) and run() pipes the instruction to `claude --verbose --output-format=stream-json ... --print` (claude_code.py:1889-1904). codex: install() runs the nvm installer then `npm install -g @openai/codex@latest` unless a version is pinned (src/harbor/agents/installed/codex.py:343-370) and run() calls `codex exec --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox --skip-git-repo-check --json` (codex.py:1433-1451). Caveat: upstream tests for both are AsyncMock-based (tests/unit/agents/installed/test_claude_code_install.py:14-34; test_agent_install_execution.py:47-71) and pytest.yml carries no model-API secrets (only CODECOV_TOKEN, .github/workflows/pytest.yml:104), so live end-to-end runs of the real CLIs are not exercised by upstream CI.

claim_checks.claim: README.md:14 - Conduct experiments in thousands of environments in parallel through providers like Daytona, Modal, LangSmith, Blaxel, Novita Sandbox, Tensorlake, and Runta.

risks: Telemetry is on by default, also in CI, and the README does not mention it: PostHog events are sent after CLI commands and jobs (src/harbor/telemetry.py:40-45,411-436,479-480,580-581; src/harbor/cli/main.py:53-77); opt-out requires HARBOR_TELEMETRY=0/false/no/off/disabled. Payload includes agent/model names, dataset refs, token/cost totals and public repo refs, which needs an extra unauthenticated probe of the git host (telemetry.py:82-160,726-781); the older docs say repo org/name is never collected (docs/content/docs/usage-stats.mdx:85). Default dataset and package-task resolution also depends on a Hub Supabase project with an embedded publishable key (src/harbor/auth/constants.py:7-13; src/harbor/registry/client/factory.py:34-45), so `-d`/`-t` runs need Hub network access while local `-p` runs do not.

Runs are not hermetic or version-pinned by default: the agent CLI is fetched at trial time (Claude Code via `curl ... downloads.claude.ai/.../bootstrap.sh | bash`, Codex via the nvm installer plus `npm install -g @openai/codex@latest`), and the `version` option is 'Omit for latest' (src/harbor/agents/installed/claude_code.py:436-449; codex.py:352-370; src/harbor/agents/options.py:59-62); the resolved version is detected only best-effort after install (src/harbor/agents/installed/base.py:1056-1064). Example verifiers also apt-get/curl uv and pytest at verify time (examples/tasks/hello-world/tests/test.sh:3-13), and the default task network mode is `public` (src/harbor/models/task/config.py:250-251), so results depend on live upstream releases and network unless pinned and restricted.

No CI-gate semantics: there is no pass-rate/threshold option and no reward-based exit status after a job (src/harbor/cli/jobs.py:2106-2151; src/harbor/models/job/config.py:396-461). Agent/API failures (rate limit, usage limit, auth) are classified as typed exceptions but the verifier still runs afterwards, a missing reward counts as 0 in `mean`, pass@k is computed only for single-key 0/1 rewards, and retries default to 0 (src/harbor/trial/single_step.py:75-87; src/harbor/metrics/base.py:14-35; src/harbor/utils/pass_at_k.py:44-51; src/harbor/models/job/config.py:291-322; src/harbor/agents/installed/base.py:34-160). A CI wrapper would have to parse jobs/<job>/result.json itself, and the CLI prompts for host-env confirmation unless -y/--yes is passed (src/harbor/cli/jobs.py:291-295,953-963). `harbor analyze`/`check` default to Claude Code with Anthropic models and exit non-zero only on analysis errors (src/harbor/cli/analyze.py:100-101,206-207,258-259,367-368).

Harbor itself can delete or alter failure evidence: a retried trial's directory is rmtree'd before the next attempt (src/harbor/trial/queue.py:222); re-running an existing job directory deletes trial dirs lacking result.json (src/harbor/job.py:261-269); `harbor job resume` deletes trial dirs whose exception is CancelledError by default (src/harbor/cli/jobs.py:2186-2195,2305-2351); finalization rewrites text files to replace sensitive env values with [REDACTED] (src/harbor/trial/trial.py:1008-1053); verifier logs can be filtered with include_logs/exclude_logs (src/harbor/models/trial/config.py:323-339). The verifier ignores the test script's exit code and merges stderr into test-stdout.txt (src/harbor/verifier/verifier.py:229-232; src/harbor/utils/scripts.py:153-158).

Agents run with permission checks disabled and API keys in the container environment: Claude Code defaults to --permission-mode=bypassPermissions with IS_SANDBOX=1 and Codex runs with --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox (src/harbor/agents/installed/claude_code.py:77-88,1828-1831; codex.py:1438). The default verifier shares the agent's container (a separate verifier sandbox is opt-in: docs-mintlify/core-concepts/tasks/verifier.mdx:49-59); egress control needs nftables kernel support and a NET_ADMIN/NET_RAW sidecar (docs-mintlify/core-concepts/tasks/network-policies.mdx:53; src/harbor/environments/docker/docker-compose-egress-control.yaml:9-11). No SECURITY policy file exists; stable releases are published from a maintainer machine with a PyPI token (scripts/publish.sh:55) with no signing or attestation step, while nightly uses OIDC trusted publishing (.github/workflows/nightly.yml:25-56).

Upstream verification does not exercise the real CLIs or the multi-scorer component in PR CI: claude-code/codex tests are AsyncMock-based and pytest.yml exposes only CODECOV_TOKEN (tests/unit/agents/installed/test_agent_install_execution.py:47-71; .github/workflows/pytest.yml:104); Docker e2e tests use oracle/nop and Terminus-2 with a fake LLM server (tests/integration/test_hello_user_e2e.py:25-54); pytest.yml runs only `tests/`, so packages/rewardkit (13 test files), harbor-langsmith (3) and harbor-atif2otel (6) run in no workflow, only in maintainer publish scripts (scripts/publish-rewardkit.sh:5; scripts/publish.sh:27-38; publish-harbor-atif2otel.sh:5). CI uses Python 3.13 only although >=3.12 is declared (pytest.yml:42-43; pyproject.toml:9) and has no macOS runner.

Maintenance and documentation drift: pre-1.0 with frequent minor releases (v0.21.0 2026-08-10, v0.22.0 2026-08-22, v0.23.0 2026-09-12) and breaking changes listed under Unreleased (CHANGELOG.md:3-60; docs-mintlify/changelog.mdx:6-49; CITATION.cff:7-8; docs-mintlify/contributing/release-policy.mdx:13-16). Two doc trees coexist: docs/ (Fumadocs, deployed by deploy-docs-preview.yml:68-77) and docs-mintlify/ (deployed at docs.harborframework.com: docs-mintlify/README.md:3-4); the CLI reference, API/SDK reference and RewardKit quick-start in docs-mintlify are placeholders (docs-mintlify/cli-reference/index.mdx:6; api-sdk-reference/index.mdx:6; core-concepts/rewardkit/quick-start.mdx:6-8); the RL doc uses a removed class (docs/content/docs/training-workflows/rl.mdx:38); example job configs use the deprecated `orchestrator:` key (examples/configs/agents/claude-code-job.yaml:4-7; src/harbor/models/job/config.py:354-393).

Platform, scope and licensing limits: local runs need the docker CLI and a running daemon (src/harbor/environments/docker/docker.py:171-189) with docker compose; local Docker/Podman/Apple container declare no GPU support (src/harbor/environments/base.py:753-758); WSL2 and Docker-on-macOS are undocumented and macOS is not in CI. The scorer model is per-task verifier scripts plus optional RewardKit (LLM/agent judges are non-deterministic and need provider credentials: docs/content/docs/rewardkit/index.mdx:365-391), not a labeled-dataset scorer registry. Harbor and its packages are Apache-2.0 (LICENSE; pyproject.toml:6), but adapters wrap third-party datasets under their own terms (e.g. crustbench notes GNU GPL: adapters/crustbench/README.md:19,29) and vendor MIT/Apache evaluator code (adapters/dacode/template/tests/evaluators/LICENSE; adapters/osworld/src/osworld/task-template/tests/evaluators/upstream/LICENSE). Hosted rollouts require a Hub account, API key and approval (docs-mintlify/core-concepts/hosted-harbor/index.mdx:9-12).
